modules.module_title: Receive metal ware products and acids

pcs.pc_description: receive metal ware products and acids to be used in cleaning from the supervisor.
follow standard operating procedure while handling the metal ware and the prescribed acids.

modules.module_title: Soak metal ware product in specified acid

pcs.pc_description: place a tub / big container at the appropriate place in the working area and fill it with water.
dip all the metal ware products one by one in the water filled tub / big container.
take out the products and leave it outside for drying and clean it with cloth/rug after drying.
dip the cleaned metal ware products in tub/ big container filled with specified acid.
keep the products there as per the standard operating procedure of the company.
ensure the metal ware product is soaked well and suitable for the next process requirement.

modules.module_title: Rinse the metal ware product with water

pcs.pc_description: take out the products from acid as per the standard operating procedure of the company.
rinse the product thoroughly with water.
visually inspect and ensure good quality of cleaning.
place the product at suitable and stable position on appropriate surface.
ensure appropriate safety measures are followed during handling of acids.
ensure concentration of acid in solution is as per the standard operating procedure of the company.
ensure there is no metal dissolution of the product during the process.
ensure porosity is not developed in the product during acid cleaning process.
ensure surface cleaning is as per specifications.
